title: The perfect casting does not exi- #OhMary #JaneKrakowski #ColeEscola ...
transcript: I'm gonna need everyone to stop everything because Jane Krakowski is joining the cast of oh, Mary. And I cannot think about anything else. Like, sorry to my job and all of my other responsibilities. This is all I'm going to be thinking about for the next couple days. Like, I remember her name being thrown around as one of the, like, dream of Mary Todd Lincoln's, and I remember thinking, well, yeah, that's perfect, but that's never gonna happen. Well, it happened. And, like, shout out to the Omar casting team, because they are truly the hardest working people on Broadway. they just consistently give us great casting after great casting, from Titus Burgess to Jinx Monsoon, and even in the supporting roles, like Kumail Nanjiani, Michael Yuri, all just brilliant casting choices. I just continue to be like, okay, I'll go back one more time. And then they get me again. Like, I can't not go see Jane Krakowski as Mary Todd Lincoln. Anyways, I'm about to go take out a second mortgage so I can go see oh, Mary for a fourth time, which I think might be the most I've seen a single play on Broadway. And something tells me it won't be the last.
